verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-processing SaaS with an SDK, a CLI and on-prem containers, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out setting. Air-gapped on-prem deployment and BAA/DPA terms are related privacy features, not a user-facing opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
